purpose: Builds S3-compatible public media URLs from persisted object keys and backend-owned media versions.
businessRules: Persisted HTTP/HTTPS URLs pass through unchanged.
Object keys are normalized with a leading slash.
Configured S3-compatible public asset base URL is prepended without double slashes.
When a version is supplied, append v as a query parameter for cache busting.
Frontend must consume generated URLs instead of rebuilding storage paths.
The configured media base URL is required; missing media origin config should fail fast instead of returning broken relative paths.
